title: Cigogo (forged iron bells)
summary: Four tall bells of forged iron, each welded from two plates, stand side by side on a bench. Struck with an iron rod they ring short and bright; the tallest is the deepest.
howToPlay: Four bells are lit: Deep, Medium, Small and Bright.
Strike the bell a closing ring marks.
Keep the pulse steady: the bells are the clock for the dance.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and extra strokes cost points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: A set of iron bells gives a dance its time line: the same pattern returns again and again while drums and voices play around it.
credits: Tradition: the tall iron bells of the Idoma and neighbours; patterns written for this game
